messages.author: 168ba93d93d9d7d7
messages.subject: reroot gives error
parts:
>reroot(tr,868)
Loading required package: phytools
Error in loadNamespace(name) : there is no package called ‘phytools’

> class(tr)
[1] "phylo"

> str(tr)
List of 5
 $ edge       : int [1:965, 1:2] 485 485 486 487 488 488 487 486 489 490 ...
 $ Nnode      : int 482
 $ tip.label  : chr [1:484] "A_rbcL|233" "B_rbcL|223" "C_rbcL|234" "D_rbcL|108" ...
 $ edge.length: num [1:965] 0.019013 0.033926 0.024371 0.012535 0.000001 ...
 $ node.label : chr [1:482] "" "100" "100" "100" ...
 - attr(*, "class")= chr "phylo"
 - attr(*, "order")= chr "cladewise"

Version:
ggtree_1.5.9

Phytools cannot be installed because the dependency mnomt requires compilation (there is sourcecode only) and fails.
ERROR: dependencies 'mnormt', 'msm' are not available for package 'phytools'

install.packages("mnormt") returns Error: source only, needs compilation
